syllabus_topics: Introduction: Generalities, classification, and examples of fluid-mechanic systems and machines
Energy balance in a hydraulic turbomachine: Energy equation for a hydraulic machine, useful head and power, degree of reaction, losses, powers, and efficiencies. Operating point of a pumping system.
Similarity in turbomachines: Dimensional analysis of turbomachinery, similarity laws, design point, specific speed, efficiency of a turbomachinery family.
Cavitación and water hammer: Cavitation, net suction head, and water hammer.
One-dimensional theory of turbomachines: One-dimensional flow, velocity triangles, and Euler head for radial and axial machines. Isolated profile model for axial turbomachines.
Pumps and fans: Classification, typical pump installation, pumping system operating point, pump coupling, description of centrifugal pumps and fans.
Turbines: Classification, usage region of a hydraulic turbine, characteristic curves and turbine installation, description of impulse and reaction turbines.
Positive displacement and special machines: Classification, linear, rotary, and special machines.
